simple.summary: חֳרֵם (Chŏrêm) means Chorem , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 38.

definitions.full: H2765. Chorem חֳרֵם proper name, of a location ( sacred ; compare Sabean proper name, of a location אחרם DHM Epigr. Denkm. 43 ) — a place in tribe of Naphtali Josh 19:38 (P); not identified.
